quest.title: The Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Drumalong Festival
quest.description: Having been invited via letter by Itto, you decide to see what this Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Drumalong Festival is all about.

talks.objective: Talk to the Tenryou Commission Doushin Kimura

dialogues.speaker: Kimura
dialogues.text: Oh, do you need a hand with anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Isn't there supposed to be a festival soon?

dialogues.speaker: Kimura
dialogues.text: What? A festival? I haven't heard anything about a festival coming up.

dialogues.speaker: Kimura
dialogues.text: Uh, could you be more specific? What festival are you talking about, exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's the Almighty Arataki—

dialogues.speaker: Kimura
dialogues.text: Almighty Arataki...?

choices.text: The, um, Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's the Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Drumalong Festival, organized by the Arataki Gang!

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: Ah yes! The same Arataki Gang who made a scene at the Irodori Festival?

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: So, you're here for the unauthorized, unprofessional, and unofficial event, huh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? No, no, no, it's not un-anything! It's the Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Drumalong Festival!

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: Yeah, I gotcha, no need to keep re-hashing the name. I think I know what this is about, let me bring you up to speed.

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: So we saw the members of the Arataki Gang here a few days ago. And they were busy at work leaving piles of hideous things all over the place.

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: Their leader claimed to be hosting a grand event, big enough to rival the Irodori Festival. I think that must be the one you're talking about.

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: I asked them a couple of questions and it quickly became clear that they had no permit to host the event, no proof of venue hire, and — surprise, surprise — no record of having registered the event with the Police Station.

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: Pff. If that isn't the definition of an unauthorized, unprofessional, and unofficial festival, I don't know what is. According to the rules, we had to force them to shut down the event.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? You shut it down!? ...Let Paimon guess, then you arrested them, hmm?

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: No, actually. Seeing that they had no prior experience organizing events, and they'd at least gone to the trouble of preparing a safety plan, we just gave them a warning.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Safety plan? Huh, that's pretty responsible...

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: Anyway, if you are looking for the Arataki Gang, you could try going to Amakane Island.

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: Which is a venue designated by the Yashiro Commission for use in all kinds of festivals, big and small. It was established to try and encourage community cultural events. The application process is much simpler there, and less expensive, too.

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: We told the Arataki Gang about that.

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: If they still want to host their event, that's gonna be their best option.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hmm... this whole thing is starting to sound like a non-starter, {NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But, since we've come this far... we might as well go and take a look at Amakane Island, right?

choices.text: The, heh, Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Drumalong...

talks.objective: Go to Amakane Island and look for the Arataki Gang

dialogues.speaker: Kimura
dialogues.text: Do you have any other questions?

dialogues.speaker: Kimura
dialogues.text: If you want to find the Arataki Gang, try Amakane Island.

talks.objective: Talk to Hirohiko, the Yashiro Commission Representative

dialogues.speaker: Hirohiko
dialogues.text: How can I help?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're looking for the Arataki Gang.

dialogues.speaker: Hirohiko
dialogues.text: Ah yes, you must be here for the Almighty Arataki Whatchamacallit Festival, too?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Too"?

dialogues.speaker: Hirohiko
dialogues.text: Yep, Madam Kujou Sara of the Tenryou Commission and Yoimiya of Naganohara Fireworks have both been here so far.

dialogues.speaker: Hirohiko
dialogues.text: Yoimiya noticed them getting the venue ready when she was here to deliver some fireworks. I guess she got curious and went to go check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Hirohiko
dialogues.text: As to what Madam Kujou Sara was here for, I'm not quite sure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Whoa, so other people got here before us? That's a good sign, {NICKNAME}, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So where's the Arataki Gang now?

dialogues.speaker: Hirohiko
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, since there's no space available at any official venues at the moment...

dialogues.speaker: Hirohiko
dialogues.text: ...we had to allocate them to a tiny beach at the northwest part of the island.

dialogues.speaker: Hirohiko
dialogues.text: If only they'd applied earlier, we could've given them a better location.

dialogues.speaker: Hirohiko
dialogues.text: Head northwest, you'll see them.

talks.objective: Go to the tidal flats on northwest Amakane Island

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's this festival got in store for us?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hahahaha! A ton of totally awesome stuff!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: See that hill over there? That's Singalong Hill. Stand at the top, look out over the sea, and sing your heart out.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: And this bonfire, it's perfect for roasting Lavender Melons, the regular kind or the ones of the annoying little floating variety.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: And these boxes. Plenty of space whether you wanna play Genius Invokation TCG or a-battle some beetles.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, you really pulled out all the stops.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: But of course, the highlight of this festival is the Drumalong. Here, feast your eyes on this.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Just between you and me, this little treasure was sourced through a top-secret channel. They said it's a prized hand drum that once belonged to a renowned onmyouji, and it's worth 8 million Mora!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Thanks to my strapping good looks and the fact that the vendor and I kinda had a connection — her words, not mine — she gave me a generous discount, and only asked for 800 thousand Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She went from 8 million to 800 thousand just like that? Uh... sounds suspiciously like a scam to Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Duh, haha! Oldest trick in the book, right? Which is why it didn't work on me.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I spotted the damage on the edge right away. Practically screamed "defective product alert"! "Ooh, we have a connection"... Gimme a break!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: So I haggled hard and took her down to 80 G's, hahahaha! Practically a steal!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah... more specifically, daylight robbery...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, it's pretty impressive that you could actually afford something worth 80 thousand Mora. Good for you, Bull-Chucker.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Pfft, it's only 80 thousand Mora. What do you take me for!

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: I put in 20 grand...

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: Me too...

dialogues.speaker: Akira
dialogues.text: Huh? Boss, how come I had to pay 30 grand?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: 20 grand plus 20 grand plus 30 grand...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, you really are a bull-chucker! You extorted 80 grand from your gang members and didn't pay a single Mora yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ahem, you might wanna check your mathematics there! I paid my share... y'know, I paid the last 10 grand!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Alright, good chat, but we should wrap things up. It's getting late, I should go rendezvous with Shinobu.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: This festival's just getting started. We need to keep plugging it to get a bigger crowd!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Take care of the hand drum, alright? Oh, and if you wanna try out the Drumalong at any point, Genta's your guy.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Laters, compadre!

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: I'm Genta, the Arataki Drumalong Festival Welcome Ambassador. Are you ready for your Drumalong performance?

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: Oh, I almost forgot, there's something that Boss forgot to mention to you about this hand drum.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: Since none of us really know if it's in tune or not, please test it out first.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: That way, it'll sound better when you deliver your final performance.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: Go on, give it a try.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hahahahaha! Hey there, compadres! You finally made it!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I was just wondering when you'd be showing up, next thing I know, boom. There you are. Hahaha, boy, am I happy to see you.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Look at this venue. What do you think? Is this a prime location or what?

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: It's surrounded by sea, the air is as fresh as it gets, there's no noise pollution from the city, and the views are simply spectacular.

dialogues.speaker: Akira
dialogues.text: The venue is situated against the backdrop of Amakane Island, where you can enjoy exclusive access to the Festival and Culture Center's first-rate equipment.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: With excellent transport links by sea and lands, getting where you need to be is highly convenient — whether you're traveling by foot or by boat.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: The moment I set eyes on this venue, I knew this was the one!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: It was the moment that changed the world.

response.speaker: Arataki Gang Members
response.text: Give it up for the boss!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Clearly, you're only here because the Tenryou Commission sent you away.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ahem... alright, let's get down to business.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: I invited you all here to attend the Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Drumalong Festival! A highly important festival, I might add.

response.speaker: Genta
response.text: Yeah, Boss said the first goal of the festival is to promote the Arataki Gang and recruit new members.

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: Secondly, it's to celebrate Shinobu's graduation!

response.speaker: Akira
response.text: And last but not least, it makes up for all the previous team building events that were canceled due to insufficient funding.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Three festivals in one, wow.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Akira... we can leave that last point out from now on.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Where is Shinobu?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: The thing with festivals is, you gotta get out there and promote them far and wide if you want to get a good crowd. So Shinobu's handing out flyers.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Shinobu's supposed to be the star of the show, isn't she?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How come she's out there working her butt off while you're hanging around here doing nothing?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hey, I'm hard at work too! I'm, uh... entertaining guests!

response.speaker: Genta
response.text: Boss actually just got back.

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: He said he was expecting you to arrive any second, so he came back specially to welcome you.

response.speaker: Akira
response.text: Until then, he was out there with Shinobu working hard to bring more people to the festival.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Just—Just doin' my duty. Nothin' more, nothin' less.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, this bull-chucker actually did some serious work for once. Paimon's pleasantly surprised.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hmph, trust a puny little flying Lavender Melon to stoop to the level of childish name-calling!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Anyway, so, compadre — you got any questions about this festival?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I heard Kujou Sara came?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oh, you mean that stupid tengu?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Yeah, I hesitated, but... I sent her an invitation.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I cannot believe how ungrateful she is. Get this — she came all the way out here just to put up a bulletin board and write a load of baloney on it, claiming that visitors need to be cautioned.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: She even warned us not to change it. It's blatant bullying of the gang, that's what it is...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: One day, I'm gonna defeat that tengu fair and square, in broad daylight, in the middle of the street! She'll get what's coming to her!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I heard Yoimiya showed up, too?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: The owner of Naganohara Fireworks?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Chatting with her is a real blast. She only found out about our festival because she happened to be delivering some fireworks to Amakane Island.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: She really liked what we're trying to do here, and came to pass on her best wishes. She even said she'll provide some fireworks for us next time.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Looks like the Arataki Gang should make sure to keep good ties with Naganohara Fireworks in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Akira
dialogues.text: I'm Akira, the Arataki Drumalong Festival Feedback Ambassador. So, can you give us some feedback?

response.speaker: Akira
response.text: Got it. Thank you for your feedback.

response.speaker: Akira
response.text: Hmm? You have other questions? But I don't really have anything else to say.

response.speaker: Akira
response.text: Uh... The boss said my only job was to say two things: "Can you give us some feedback?" and "Thank you for your feedback."

response.speaker: Akira
response.text: And if the guests ask when they will receive a response to their feedback, I'm supposed to say: "We'll get back to you as soon as possible."

response.speaker: Akira
response.text: He said that's what people do in other events he's been to. I'm sure he's basing this on a wealth of experience.

response.speaker: Akira
response.text: But then Shinobu told me that's too insincere, so she gave me this notebook.

response.speaker: Akira
response.text: Look here, I've made a note of your feedback, and I'll show it to Shinobu when she gets back.

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: I'm Mamoru, the Arataki Drumalong Festival Atmosphere Ambassador. How may I help?

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: You're asking what my job is?

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: Well, as the atmosphere ambassador, my job is mainly to create a lively atmosphere and give all attendants the feeling of "I'm so hyped I'm going out of my mind."

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: Do you feel that way?

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: ...Hey, don't say that!

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: That was really disheartening, it's like being punched in the gut! If that's how you feel... my job's meaningless, isn't it?

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: You are the boss's friend. Please, show me some support for his sake. I'm begging you, say the line!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What line?

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: You know, "I'm so hyped I'm going out of my mind."

choices.text: I'm so hyped I'm going out of my mind.

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: Great! Awesome!

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: This is the best recognition I could ask for!

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: Come on, people! More music, more dancing, let's keep this party going!

choices.text: I'm so... I'm so... I'm sorry, I just can't.

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: Ugh... fine. Well, I guess I should at least keep trying, seeing how everyone else in the gang is working hard trying to do their jobs, too...

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: You can punch me in the gut, but I won't give up! Just like the boss says!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Same situation as earlier. The Arataki Gang is nowhere in sight.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There should be a Yashiro Commission representative here. Let's go and ask him.
